disclaimer: Always patch-test. Consult a dermatologist for skin concerns.

cards.title: IN Instagram voice
cards.voice: Warm, clear, science-backed without jargon. Hinglish ok for hooks; benefits stay plain English. Never joke about skin disease.
do: Lead with skin feel and routine fit for Indian weather
Cite dermatologist-tested when the claim is approved
Keep CTA soft: try, explore, add to routine
dont: Never claim cures, heals, or #1 rankings
No medical advice or disease treatment language

cards.title: IN LinkedIn voice
cards.voice: Professional, evidence-first. Speak to pharmacists and derm partners. No slang.
do: Lead with formulation facts and market fit
dont: No consumer slang as a claim

cards.title: IN visual kit (all channels)
cards.voice: Clean clinical white + soft blue accents. Real skin tones. Logo clear-space locked in code.
do: Composite logo.svg and disclaimer.txt in code, never in the image model
dont: Do not let the model redraw the logo or invent legal text
